ARCHITECTURE OVERVIEW

A layered trust model

QuantaVoice is designed as a layered authentication concept. The cards below describe the intended control areas; they are an architecture overview, not a live banking connection or a claim of production certification.

01

Voice assurance

Speaker verification, liveness assessment and anti-spoofing checks help assess whether a voice request is genuine.

ECAPA-TDNNAASIST
02

Adaptive authentication

Risk signals can determine when additional verification is required before a payment is approved.

Risk scoringStep-up checks
03

Post-quantum protection

Post-quantum cryptographic mechanisms are considered for identity, key establishment and transaction authorization.

ML-KEMML-DSA
04

Payment integrity

Transaction context and cryptographic authorization are intended to help protect payment approval from replay and tampering.

Transaction bindingReplay resistance
